metadata.question: Did San Jose have a higher average nitrogen dioxide concentration than Los Angeles from 2018 to 2019?

<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2 (primary) for 2018-01-01 to 2019-12-31; fallback to COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2 if empty.
- Locations: San Jose, CA (37.3382, -121.8863) and Los Angeles, CA (34.0522, -118.2437), each buffered by 20 km.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Apply QA mask: qa_value >= 0.75 (recommended for S5P tropospheric NO2).

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collection size is 0 after fallback: C1.
- If valid pixel count after QA mask is 0 for either city: C2.
- If mean is null or not finite: C3.
- Else compare means: A if San Jose > Los Angeles, otherwise B.
</thinking>

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const start = '2018-01-01';
  const end = '2019-12-31';
  const band = 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density';
  const scale = 10000;

  const sanJose = ee.Geometry.Point([-121.8863, 37.3382]).buffer(20000);
  const losAngeles = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.2437, 34.0522]).buffer(20000);

  // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
  function withQaMask(img) {
    const qa = img.select('qa_value');
    const mask = qa.gte(0.75);
    return img.select(band).updateMask(mask).copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']);
  }

  let dataset = 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2';
  let col = ee.ImageCollection(dataset).filterDate(start, end);
  let sizeOffl = await col.size().getInfo();
  if (!sizeOffl || sizeOffl === 0) {
    dataset = 'COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2';
    col = ee.ImageCollection(dataset).filterDate(start, end);
  }
  const sizeChosen = await col.size().getInfo();
  if (!sizeChosen || sizeChosen === 0) {
    console.log(`Images: 0 (OFFL), 0 (NRTI)`);
    console.log('C1: Empty Collection');
    console.log('C1');
    return;
  }

  const maskedCol = col.map(withQaMask);

  async function cityStats(name, roi) {
    const meanImg = maskedCol.mean();
    // Count valid pixels in the mean image (i.e., pixels with at least one valid observation)
    const validDict = await meanImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    }).getInfo();

    const totalDict = await ee.Image.constant(1).rename('const').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    }).getInfo();

    const validPix = validDict ? (validDict[band] || 0) : 0;
    const totalPix = totalDict ? (totalDict['const'] || 0) : 0;

    // Mean concentration across ROI
    const meanDict = await meanImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    }).getInfo();
    const meanVal = meanDict ? meanDict[band] : null;

    return { name, meanVal, validPix, totalPix };
  }

  const sj = await cityStats('San Jose', sanJose);
  const la = await cityStats('Los Angeles', losAngeles);

  console.log(`Dataset: ${dataset} (images: ${sizeChosen})`);
  console.log(`Date: ${start} to ${end}, Scale: ${scale} m`);

  // 3. Validation
  if ((sj.totalPix || 0) === 0 || (la.totalPix || 0) === 0) {
    console.log('Pixel grid error (total=0) for at least one ROI.');
    console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
    console.log('C3');
    return;
  }
  if ((sj.validPix || 0) === 0 || (la.validPix || 0) === 0) {
    console.log(`San Jose validPix=${sj.validPix}, Los Angeles validPix=${la.validPix}`);
    console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels after QA mask');
    console.log('C2');
    return;
  }
  if (!isFinite(sj.meanVal) || !isFinite(la.meanVal) || sj.meanVal === null || la.meanVal === null) {
    console.log(`Invalid mean(s): SJ=${sj.meanVal}, LA=${la.meanVal}`);
    console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
    console.log('C3');
    return;
  }

  const sjPct = (100 * sj.validPix / sj.totalPix).toFixed(1);
  const laPct = (100 * la.validPix / la.totalPix).toFixed(1);
  console.log(`San Jose: mean=${sj.meanVal.toExponential(3)}, validPix=${sj.validPix}/${sj.totalPix} (${sjPct}%)`);
  console.log(`Los Angeles: mean=${la.meanVal.toExponential(3)}, validPix=${la.validPix}/${la.totalPix} (${laPct}%)`);

  // 4. Final Answer
  const sjHigher = sj.meanVal > la.meanVal;
  console.log(`SJ>LA: ${sjHigher}`);
  console.log(sjHigher ? 'A: Yes' : 'B: No');
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
